label: uses protocol
type: the subject component communicates using the named wire protocol. Object is a protocol concept.
note: Promoted at merged recurrence 4, folding streamsMutationsVia. Both agents in round 11 independently minted a predicate for the same fact - 'the Data Service uses the DCP protocol to stream data-mutations' - one general (usesProtocol), one specific (streamsMutationsVia). Kept the general form because the specific one bakes its object's purpose into the predicate name, which stops it ever being used for a second protocol. This is the expected cross-agent near-duplicate that the extract skill says reconciliation exists to catch, and it is the second time the registry has had to fold a specific predicate into a general one (see availableSince folding requiresMinVersionFor).
